Name: Horns as Headgears
Author: keodau27
Description:
[center][size=3][b]As requested, i have uploaded a xnb version, all 3 versions are included in the file, please choose one and drop it in Content\Characters\Farmer
[/b][/size]
===================================

﻿This mod is inspired from[url=https://community.playstarbound.com/threads/antlers-as-a-hat.145669] this topic [/url]﻿[/center][center][b]It comes in 2 versions : basic and fantasy, you can choose to have either one or both versions[/b]

The horns from left -> right  are based on horns of a Markhorn, Narwhal/Unicorn, Ibex,  Japanese Oni, Sheep, Deer

[b]They will replace these hats ingame :[/b] 
+Basic & Fantasy : Cowboy hat, Official cap, Bowler hat, Top hat,Sombrero, Straw hat
+Both version : Same as above, Plum Chapeau, Chicken Mask, Goblin Mask, Skeleton Mask, Blue Bonnet 

[b]The basic version is a clean, horn-only version[/b]

How it looks on bright-colored hair
[img]https://i.imgur.com/VZJtFk0.png[/img]﻿

How it looks on dark hair
[img]https://i.imgur.com/UiV20h4.png[/img]﻿

[b]The fantasy version is horns with flower and vines growing on them, giving off a fantasy-ish vibe, doesn't have the oni horns
[/b]
On bright-colored hair
[img]https://i.imgur.com/qoJ3aIQ.png[/img]

On dark hair
[img]https://i.imgur.com/M8sRYky.png[/img][/center]

Extract the file and put the folder in Mods[/center]
